name: Flannery Foundation Scholarship (UQ)
provider: University of Queensland and Flannery Foundation
summary: Aspire scheme scholarship for Queensland Commitment Scholarship holders from outer regional or remote Queensland.
who: Domestic student commencing any UQ bachelor program in Semester 1, with no prior bachelor-level study.
Maximum points in the Financial Hardship category of QTAC's Educational Access Scheme, and awarded The Queensland Commitment Scholarship.
Permanent resident of an Outer Regional, Remote or Very Remote area of Queensland more than 200km from Brisbane.
how: Apply using the online form. One application covers all scholarships in the Aspire Scholarship scheme.
catches: Applications opened 17 August 2026 and close 26 February 2027.

evidence.quote: are a permanent resident of Outer Regional, Remote or Very Remote areas in Queensland
